faq.headline: Real Estate Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your real estate site.

items.question: Do listings sync automatically from an MLS?
items.answer: No MLS or property-feed integration is included in this example. Maintain featured properties in your site content.

items.question: Can buyers request a viewing?
items.answer: A form can collect a request; your agent confirms the viewing directly.

items.question: Can I feature several neighbourhoods?
items.answer: Yes. Add useful local information for the areas you serve.

items.question: What details should a property listing show?
items.answer: Include accurate photos, key property facts, location context, current status, and a clear way to ask the agent about the listing.

items.question: Will listings update automatically from an MLS or property feed?
items.answer: No property-feed integration is included in this example. You maintain the featured listing information on the site and should update it when details change.

items.question: Can visitors book a property viewing?
items.answer: A form can collect the property and preferred viewing time. The agent confirms the property status and appointment directly.
